# nexspence Provider

Manage Nexspence repositories, blob stores, and RBAC objects.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    nexspence = {
      source  = "nexspence/nexspence"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

provider "nexspence" {
  url   = "https://nexspence.example.com"
  token = var.nexspence_token
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for basic auth. Falls back to NEXSPENCE_PASSWORD.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) nxs_* API token (preferred). Falls back to NEXSPENCE_TOKEN. Mutually exclusive with username/password.
- `url` (String) Base URL of the Nexspence server. Falls back to NEXSPENCE_URL.
- `username` (String) Username for basic auth. Falls back to NEXSPENCE_USERNAME.
